_comment: Copy to server/config.json and fill in what you have. Everything is optional — the site runs live on the free providers with no keys at all. Environment variables (IV_TWELVEDATA, IV_FINNHUB, IV_MARKETAUX, IV_NEWSAPI, IV_KITEAPIKEY, IV_KITEACCESSTOKEN) override this file.
_marketaux: Free plan is metered per REQUEST. The server refreshes hourly and spends marketauxPagesPerRefresh requests each time — keep pages x 24 under your daily allowance.
